high_level_description: This image is a movie poster for the film "Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind." The poster features a surreal and emotional scene with two individuals lying on the ground, seemingly in a state of distress or exhaustion. The person on the left has blue hair and is wearing a light-colored coat, while the person on the right is dressed in darker clothing. Both appear to be huddled together, possibly seeking comfort or protection. The background is a gradient of light blue to white, giving a dreamlike quality to the scene.
